subject: Budget range validation — PayBridge monthly spend and procurement thresholds
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@paybridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + budget range validation (tokens / $/1M)

Alex — great call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we can align on pricing and procurement:

Key notes from the call:
- Primary workloads: chat + retrieval-augmented generation for customer support and summaries.
- Expected steady-state token volume: initial estimate 20M–50M tokens/month (spikes during campaigns).
- Target unit economics: your team mentioned aiming for approx $1,200 per 1M tokens (nice to confirm).
- Procurement thresholds: you flagged PO approval steps at $50k+ and need for net-30/invoice terms.

Open items / asks:
1) Can you confirm a monthly spend band you expect us to quote against? (e.g., $20k–$60k/mo)
2) Confirm whether PayBridge requires invoice + PO or DocuSign + SOW to start procurement.
3) Any SOC2 / compliance artifacts needed for procurement review?

I attached a short pricing summary and a simple cost model (cost_model.xlsx) to help map token volumes to monthly spend. If the above aligns, we can produce a formal quote (monthly and committed tiers) and SOW.

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm spend band and procurement contact/requirements (by Mon 3/23)
- Sales: produce draft quote and SOW based on confirmed band

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood_pricing_summary.pdf, cost_model.xlsx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@paybridge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@paybridge.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + budget range validation (tokens / $/1M)

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the recap.

Confirming our internal numbers:
- Estimated monthly tokens: 20M–50M (likely start closer to 25M, ramp to 40–50M over a quarter).
- Target unit cost: yes, target ~$1,200 per 1M tokens (we're modeling at $1.2k for budgeting; flexibility if committed discounts apply).
- Expected monthly spend band based on that range: roughly $24k–$60k/month.

Procurement notes:
- Procurement prefers: PO + invoice (Net 30) for anything above $25k/month. For pilots under $25k we can do a charge card purchase.
- POs over $50k need VP approval (likely 1–2 week timeline once contract + SOW are approved).
- Procurement has their standard vendor onboarding doc — I attached the form.

For SOC2: procurement will ask for SOC2 Type II report and data processing addendum. We can share our security contacts if you can send the artifacts.

Happy to move to a formal quote. Who should procurement expect the quote from, and can you include committed tiers and churn/cancellation terms?

Best,
Alex

Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Integrations | PayBridge
alex.johnson@paybridge.com

Attachment: paybridge_procurement_form.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@paybridge.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + budget range validation (tokens / $/1M)

Alex — thanks for the details and the procurement form.

Quick answers and proposal:
- We will prepare a formal quote with two options:
  1) Pilot (month-to-month): up to 25M tokens/month at $1,300 per 1M tokens (slightly higher due to pilot support / burst capacity).
  2) Committed (12-month commit): tiered pricing starting at $1,000 per 1M tokens for 50M+ committed monthly volume; 30–49M tier at $1,100 per 1M.

This will map roughly to your budget band:
- 20–25M => $26k–$32.5k/mo (pilot pricing)
- 30–50M => $33k–$50k/mo (committed tiers reduce $/1M)

Procurement flow:
- We'll provide an invoice + standard Redwood Master Services Agreement + SOW. For PO > $50k we will note VP approval lead time; we'll include language in the quote to help accelerate approvals (billing contacts, procurement contact, sample SOW).

Rishi — can you attach SOC2 Type II and the DPA to the quote packet?

Alex — I'll have a draft quote and SOW to you by EOD Tue (3/23). If that's too soon, let me know and we can move to Wed.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: SOW_template.docx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@paybridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@paybridge.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + budget range validation (tokens / $/1M)

Marissa — sounds good. Thanks for the clear options.

Procurement notes:
- We can fast-track PO if the total initial commitment is below $75k and contract language matches our standard terms (I attached an excerpt of required clauses to procurement form).
- Please send the formal quote and SOW; procurement will start review once we have the invoice and MSA.

One operational ask: can the quote include an itemized line for estimated monthly token usage and a separate line for reserved capacity / burst buffer? That helps finance forecast.

We look forward to the draft.

Thanks,
Alex
